limitations: The source lists departures per station without train IDs; trips are rebuilt by matching departures between consecutive stations.
No terminus arrival is published; it is estimated from the opposite direction and marked estimated_from_opposite_direction.
Partial trips (a train that starts or ends at an intermediate station) are kept as the source shows them and listed in partial_trips.
Interchange walking times are estimates from distance (see each walk_basis); KRL coordinates are the validated consensus values.
Public holidays follow the weekend timetable only when listed in config/mrt.json holidays.
Track shapes are unavailable; geographic simulation is disabled.
